VIRGINIA

A 12-year-old Burke, Virginia, boy has been charged with felony drug distribution for allegedly selling marijuana to a classmate at Robinson Secondary School, Fairfax County police said yesterday. Police said the boy sold marijuana to a 13-year-old student while the two were in school Jan. 5. Police declined to comment on where the 12-year-old may have gotten the marijuana or how much was allegedly sold. School officials would not comment on the specific case but said any student found to have been involved in a drug-related offense is immediately suspended. The 13-year-old was charged with marijuana possession.
